summary_md: Added a reusable CardImage component (muted background + Lucide ImageOff icon) and wired it into CardSearch, CardsPage (grid + list), and CardDetailPage so missing or broken card images always show the same on-brand placeholder instead of a blank gap, a text label, or a broken-image icon. — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 4 validation gate(s) (written), then passed on round 1 of 2 against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Booted dev server (backend :3001, frontend :5174), signed up a test user, and drove Chromium via Playwright. Verified CardImage placeholder (muted box + ImageOff icon, no layout shift) renders correctly on CardsPage grid and list views for cards with null image_url (Test Pikachu, Test Charmander), on CardDetailPage's hero image, and on real cards (Charizard etc.) when image requests were intercepted/aborted to simulate broken URLs. No broken native icons appeared, no client console errors from the image-loading path, no server errors. Unrelated pre-existing 404s (pricing/analytics endpoints with no seeded data for test cards) observed but out of scope for this image-placeholder change..
